claims: H or h is the eighth letter of the Latin alphabet
H represents a voiceless glottal fricative (/ℎ/) in English
H is the 8th most frequent letter in English
H has approx. 6.1% usage in English
In music, H can represent the note B
The /ℎ/ sound is created by exhaling from the throat with an open mouth
The /ℎ/ sound acts as a voiceless version of the following vowel
The /ℎ/ sound is generally not used at the end of English words
H is silent in words like hour, honor, honest, and herb (American English)
H is silent when following 'r', such as in rhyme or rhythm
The letter H is pronounced as /eɪtʃ/ (standard)
The letter H is pronounced as /heɪtʃ/ (common in some British, Irish, and Australian dialects)
